protocol.scope: 5 fixed Unity 6 questions x 3 repeats, 30 answers; actual retrieved S1-S3 chunk text.
protocol.rubric: correct: all essential clauses accurate; partial: some clauses present without contradiction; missing: absent; incorrect: material contradiction or wrong instruction, even if another clause is true. Partial earns no full point. Every factual claim must be entailed by supplied chunks; model knowledge outside context is unsupported. Citation label relevance is separate from claim support and retrieved file hit.
protocol.gold_availability: q1/q2/q4: S1; q3: S2+S3; q5: S1+S2; judged from chunk text for each pair.
protocol.method: Human semantic review of all unique answers and all case-specific retrieval; identical local repeats verified by SHA-256. No LLM judge.
